questions.question: Which list is in order from least to greatest?
What is 3/8 written as a percent?
What is 25% of 360?
A juice mix uses 2 parts concentrate to 5 parts water. How much water goes with 6 cups of concentrate?
questions.explanation: 6 cups is 3 times 2 cups, so use 3 times 5 cups of water: 15 cups.

questions.question: A car uses 6 L of fuel to travel 100 km. At the same rate, how much fuel does it use to travel 350 km?
questions.explanation: 350 km is 3.5 times 100 km, so the car uses 3.5 × 6 = 21 L.

questions.question: Which temperature is the warmest?
questions.explanation: On a number line, −3 is furthest to the right of these numbers, so it is the greatest (warmest).

questions.question: What is 4.8 × 3?
What is 7.2 ÷ 0.9?
What is the value of 5a − 4 when a = 6?
Solve 3k = 27.
Which value of y makes y + 4 < 10 true?
questions.explanation: y + 4 < 10 means y < 6. Of the choices, only 5 is less than 6.

questions.question: A program sets total = 3. A loop runs 4 times, and each time it doubles total. What is total at the end?
What is the median of 14, 9, 25, 9 and 18?
questions.explanation: In order: 9, 9, 14, 18, 25. The middle value is 14. (The mean is 15 and the mode is 9.)

questions.question: A number cube numbered 1 to 6 is rolled 60 times. About how many times would you expect to roll a 4?
questions.explanation: The probability of a 4 is 1/6, and 1/6 of 60 is 10.

questions.question: An L-shaped garden is made of a 6 m by 4 m rectangle joined to a 3 m by 2 m rectangle. What is its total area?
What is the volume of a rectangular prism that measures 6 cm by 5 cm by 2 cm?
questions.explanation: Volume = length × width × height = 6 × 5 × 2 = 60 cm³. (104 cm² would be its surface area.)

questions.question: Two angles together make a straight line. One of them is 128°. What is the other?
questions.explanation: Angles on a straight line add up to 180°: 180 − 128 = 52°.

questions.question: How many centimetres are in 4.25 m?
Sam puts $500 in a savings account that pays 3% simple interest per year. How much interest does he earn in 2 years?
questions.explanation: 3% of 500 dollars is 15 dollars a year, so 2 years earn 30 dollars of interest.

questions.question: Which of these is the best buy (lowest price per litre)?
questions.explanation: Per litre: 8.60 ÷ 4 = 2.15, 4.40 ÷ 2 = 2.20, 2.29, and 1.15 × 2 = 2.30 dollars. The 4 L jug is cheapest per litre.
